content.comment_body: Hello experts, does the [product_name] [version_no] support NPN signals at its inputs? Regards, [user_name].
Yes, but this applies only if the [product_name] is powered with 24V (or 12V) DC. For a two-wire NPN sensor, you need to connect a resistor—around 1000 Ohms—between the input and ground.

Only the [product_name] [version_no] variant features NPN-compatible inputs. You can find more details at [url] on page 249, which explains the digital input options—P action or N action. Expansion module [product_name] [version_no] also provides this capability.
